title: Jevons paradox: coal and data
description: Jevons paradox as an editorial split: a steam locomotive (1865: coal.) beside a server rack (2026: data.), ink line art on white on one ground line, with the paradox in one line across the bottom.
source: The brief (Nov 2026). The drawings are the page's own SVG.
